WEBHOOK_URL.description: Target URL; every selected event is POSTed as JSON { event, sessionId, ts, payload }.

EVENTS.description: Comma-separated filter: session_end, user_message, assistant_message, tool_call, hitl_request, hitl_resolved, subagent_stop, human_assigned. Empty = all.

SECRET.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret; the hex signature of the body is sent as X-Localix-Signature.

TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Per-delivery timeout. Best-effort: failures are logged, never retried.
